higher_homotopy_answer: Yes, homotopies of homotopies and a further descent coherence are genuinely appearing. But the recurrence is not an automatic infinite simplex tower. A completed phase emits an enriched oriented determinant/kernel object. Forgetting it to a scalar destroys exactly the data needed to begin the next phase. The next phase starts by treating that enriched boundary package as a new typed object and repeating incidence, relation, homotopy, and descent.
next_executable_program: Implement a finite-cutoff contract instance recording Gamma_0 on the actual defect space, Theta/W_FP, gamma, M, C_Theta, determinant and adjugate transitions, and the orientation lift. The first decisive rank test is whether Gamma_0|N_s is invertible and whether its inverse norm remains bounded as prime and grade cutoffs grow.
ten_iteration_synthesis: This series found the analytic 3-cell (weighted Weyl identity), showed singular spectral weight is harmless on nonzero Evans histories, exposed reverse source incidence as the missing symmetry equation, identified reciprocal Weyl charts as opposite phase faces, derived simultaneous determinant/kernel descent, and proved determinant-one sewing forgets orientation. The correct phase-completion output is therefore an oriented determinant-and-kernel package whose scalar Xi value is only a shadow.
